about: Judith M. Copeland is an attorney providing legal services covering Alternative Dispute Resolution, Elder Law and Estate & Trust Litigation.

Judith Copeland, who practices law in San Diego, California, was selected to Super Lawyers for 2011 - 2020. This peer designation is awarded only to a select number of accomplished attorneys in each state. The Super Lawyers selection process takes into account peer recognition, professional achievement in legal practice, and other cogent factors.

Prior to becoming an attorney, she studied at University of California College of the Law, San Francisco (formerly UC Hastings). She graduated in 1974. After passing the bar exam, she was admitted to legal practice in 1974.
